reading.title: Plant Photosynthesis and Carbon Dioxide
reading.passage: Photosynthesis is the fundamental process by which plants convert sunlight into chemical energy. During this process, plants absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere and water from soil, utilizing light energy to produce glucose and oxygen. This mechanism not only sustains plant growth but also plays a crucial role in regulating atmospheric carbon dioxide levels, making it essential for maintaining Earth's ecological balance and supporting life itself.

questions.q: According to the passage, what are the main inputs required for photosynthesis?
options: Glucose and oxygen only
Sunlight, carbon dioxide, and water
Carbon dioxide and glucose
Oxygen and sunlight only
questions.explanation: 지문에서 '식물은 대기에서 이산화탄소를 흡수하고 토양에서 물을 흡수하며 빛 에너지를 이용한다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What can be inferred from the passage about the importance of photosynthesis?
options: It only produces food for plants
It helps regulate atmospheric conditions and supports life
It removes oxygen from the atmosphere
It prevents plant growth in certain areas
questions.explanation: 지문의 마지막 부분에서 광합성이 '대기 이산화탄소 수준 조절과 지구 생태계 균형 유지에 필수적'이라고 설명합니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? 'Remote work will become the dominant work arrangement for most professionals within the next decade.' Use specific reasons and examples to support your answer.
model_sentences: I strongly agree that remote work will become the dominant work arrangement for most professionals in the coming decade due to technological advancements and changing employee preferences.
First, the rapid development of digital communication tools and cloud-based software has eliminated many geographical barriers to work collaboration.
For example, companies like Microsoft and Google have already adopted hybrid or fully remote policies, demonstrating that productivity need not depend on physical office presence.
Second, employees increasingly value work-life balance and flexibility, which remote work provides by eliminating commute times and allowing personalized work environments.
Many studies show that remote workers report higher job satisfaction and lower burnout rates compared to traditional office workers.
In conclusion, the combination of enabling technology and evolving workforce expectations makes remote work the future of professional employment.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer studying alone in a quiet environment. Others prefer studying in a group with classmates. Which do you prefer and why? Include specific reasons and details.
model_sentences: I definitely prefer studying in a group with classmates because I learn more effectively through discussion and collaboration.
When I study with others, I can explain difficult concepts to my friends, which helps me understand the material better, and I can also ask them questions immediately when I'm confused.
For instance, last semester my study group helped me understand chemistry by breaking down complex problems into simpler steps, and I got a much better grade than when I studied alone previously.
So overall, group studying is more beneficial for my learning because of the immediate feedback and different perspectives I gain from my classmates.

listening.title: Course Registration Problem with Professor
listening.script: Student: Hi Professor Chen, I wanted to talk to you about my course registration issue. I tried to enroll in your Advanced Botany class, but the system says it's full. Is there any way I can get into the course? Professor: Let me check the enrollment records. Yes, we have reached the maximum capacity of forty students. However, I can offer you a few options. First, you could join the waitlist, and if someone drops the course, you'll be automatically added. Second, I could potentially allow an override if you meet all the prerequisites and demonstrate strong commitment. Student: That sounds helpful. I've completed all the prerequisites and I'm very interested in plant physiology research. Do you think an override is possible? Professor: Your transcript looks solid. I'll submit an override request to the registrar. You should receive confirmation within two business days. In the meantime, attend the first class if you can, so you don't fall behind with the material. Student: Thank you so much, Professor. I really appreciate your help.

questions.q: What is the main problem the student is facing?
options: The student doesn't meet the prerequisites for the course
The Advanced Botany class is full and the student cannot enroll
The student needs to change their major to botany
The professor refused to teach the class this semester
questions.explanation: 학생은 식물학 수업이 정원이 다 찼기 때문에 등록할 수 없다는 문제를 언급합니다.

questions.q: What solutions does the professor suggest to the student?
options: Wait until next semester and register early
Take a different botany class instead
Join the waitlist or request an override from the registrar
Complete additional prerequisites before registering
questions.explanation: 교수는 학생에게 대기자 명단에 올라가거나 등록 담당관에 오버라이드를 신청하는 두 가지 옵션을 제시합니다.

questions.q: Why does the professor tell the student to attend the first class?
options: To make sure the student is serious about the course
To ensure the student doesn't fall behind with the course material
To give the student a chance to meet other classmates
To allow the student to decide if they really want to take the course
questions.explanation: 교수는 학생이 오버라이드 승인을 기다리는 동안 첫 수업에 참석하여 교과 내용에서 뒤처지지 않도록 권장합니다.
